dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave spline fitting along the trailing edge, exhibiting a pronounced recurve toward the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius, shape classified as acute-rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree linear slope relative to the horizontal mid-body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.5 times the vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, moderate-radius convex curve originating from the blowhole region and terminating at the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a length approximately equal to the melon's vertical thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 degrees where the melon meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white linear mark is visible on the dorsal surface anterior to the blowhole; minor irregular indentations present along the trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform turquoise-cyan color cast across the entire pixel map; clearly defined pectoral fin with a rounded leading edge and straight trailing edge.
